# Methods used across experimental physics

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| T-CRYOGENICS-THERMOMETRY | [Cryogenics and low-temperature thermometry](cryogenics-thermometry.md) | the paper reports measurements below about 4 K in a cryostat or dilution refrigerator, or bases a claim on a sample temperature, a temperature dependence, a transition temperature, a low-temperature saturation or an electron temperature measured there |
| T-DETECTOR-EFFICIENCY | [Detector efficiency and dead time](detector-efficiency.md) | the paper counts or images photons, electrons, particles or other radiation and bases a claim on absolute or relative count rates, detection efficiency, intensities, coincidence or correlation counts, spectra or arrival times, or on corrections for dead time, pile-up, dark counts or afterpulsing |
| T-FIRST-PRINCIPLES-EVIDENCE | [First-principles calculations as supporting evidence](first-principles-evidence.md) | the paper uses density functional theory or other first-principles calculations, such as DFT+U, hybrid functionals or GW, to support an experimental interpretation of a structure, band structure, band gap, magnetic order, topology, defect level or spectral assignment |
| T-MODEL-FITTING | [Fitting models to data](model-fitting.md) | the paper fits a model, lineshape, set of peaks, decay or other function to data and bases a claim on the fitted parameters, on the number of components found, or on one model fitting better than another |
| T-LOW-NOISE-ELECTRONICS | [Low-noise electronics and lock-in detection](low-noise-electronics.md) | the paper measures small voltages, currents or noise with lock-in amplifiers, preamplifiers or digitizers, or bases a claim on a lock-in signal, its phase or harmonics, a noise spectrum, or a signal close to the noise floor of the electronics |
| T-MACHINE-LEARNING-ANALYSIS | [Machine learning in data analysis](machine-learning-analysis.md) | the paper uses a trained machine-learning model, such as a neural network, boosted decision trees or a random forest, to classify, select, denoise, reconstruct or infer from data, or bases a claim on its scores, predictions, reconstructions or on what it has learned |
| T-LARGE-FACILITIES | [Measurements at large facilities](large-facilities.md) | the paper reports data taken at a synchrotron, neutron source or X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL), such as scattering, diffraction or absorption spectroscopy, and bases a claim on them |
| T-MONTE-CARLO-INFERENCE | [Monte Carlo and simulation-based inference](monte-carlo-inference.md) | the paper derives parameters, posteriors, confidence regions or predictions from Monte Carlo simulation, Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling, simulated templates or simulation-based (likelihood-free or neural) inference, or interprets data by comparison with simulated events or configurations |
| T-IMAGE-ANALYSIS | [Quantitative image analysis](image-analysis.md) | the paper extracts numbers from images taken with an optical or electron microscope, camera or scanning probe, such as intensities, sizes, shapes, counts, areas, distances or lattice spacings, by correction, segmentation, thresholding, filtering or an automated or machine-learning pipeline |
| T-SAMPLE-ENVIRONMENT | [Sample environment control](sample-environment.md) | the paper bases a claim on the magnetic field, strain, electric field or atmosphere at the sample, on hysteresis between sweep directions in temperature, field or gate voltage, on coercive fields or field-cooled and zero-field-cooled comparisons, or on data from a strain cell |
| T-VACUUM-SURFACES | [Vacuum, surface preparation and contamination](vacuum-surfaces.md) | the result depends on a clean surface or a controlled gas environment: measurements in high or ultra-high vacuum, surfaces prepared by sputtering, annealing or cleaving, gas dosing, air exposure or transfer between instruments, or a claim that a surface is free of contamination |
| T-REPRODUCIBILITY-ACROSS-SAMPLES | [Variation between samples and laboratories](reproducibility-across-samples.md) | a claim rests on one or a few samples, devices, crystals, films or runs, reports a best or representative sample, compares samples or batches, tracks ageing or degradation, or compares results between laboratories, including round-robin or interlaboratory comparisons |
